leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a recursive function to invert a binary tree
Apply tree traversal techniques to manipulate node connections
Construct a solution that swaps left and right child nodes at each level
Initialize and test the inversion algorithm with sample binary trees
Manipulate tree structure by reassigning node references
Integrate base cases to handle empty trees or leaf nodes
Control the recursion flow to traverse all nodes systematically
